scope: Full product plan; packages only verified after specified acceptance

packages.name: Product and contracts
packages.deliverables: Supported app categories, API contract, policy envelope, architecture decisions, provenance rules
packages.acceptance: Approved specification; no competitor code in dependencies/templates; customer interviews recorded.
packages.remaining: Original contracts and provenance guardrails exist; customer interviews, approved product/legal/policy envelope and independent provenance review remain open.

packages.name: Toolchain and local build
packages.deliverables: Signed version lock, SDK installation, doctor, native project generation, local CI
packages.acceptance: Clean machine builds FieldLog for both targets with reproducible input graph.
packages.remaining: CLI creation/locked source export and generated iOS consumer work locally. Signed toolchain distributions, Android project generation, clean-machine immutable package builds and full FieldLog graph remain open. The root public SDK package is published at d8c6965; separate FieldLog d51adf5 consumes its immutable remote MixerCore product in the native task editor with 17 host tests and one simulator workflow. Full packaging/ABI/toolchain lifecycle, independent distribution and dogfood gates remain open.

packages.name: Core Swift model
packages.deliverables: Lifecycle, state, effects, navigation model, resources, errors
packages.acceptance: Same state/effect tests in native targets; restoration works.
packages.remaining: Bounded core/state/effects/resource/navigation values and strict UI codecs are tested; full lifecycle/restoration, platform parity and broader public adoption remain open. FieldLog now uses the public state/effect API for its native task editor; full MixerUI/guest adoption is still pending.

packages.name: iOS UI adapter
packages.deliverables: Public MixerUI implementation, SwiftUI/UIKit mapping, input and accessibility
packages.acceptance: D1 and UI matrix pass on physical iOS.
packages.remaining: Generated iOS native renderer runs in a simulator. Physical engine-based FieldLog D1, full UI/navigation matrix and accessibility remain open.

packages.name: Android UI adapter
packages.deliverables: JNI boundary, Compose/native controls, lifecycle, back behavior, native resources
packages.acceptance: D2 with native Android interaction and accessibility evidence.
packages.remaining: Physical Pixel Swift/JNI/native widget interactions pass for a checklist slice. FieldLog D2, published SDK use, process restoration, full UI/IME/TalkBack/device/performance matrices remain open.

packages.name: Capability generator
packages.deliverables: Schema, generated adapters, ownership/cancellation, permission metadata
packages.acceptance: Cross-language codec and lifecycle suite; first native plugin consumed by FieldLog.
packages.remaining: Typed HTTP/storage schema, generated adapters, grant intersection and bounded host/storage lifecycle pass host/cross-compiler checks. Signed v2 grants pass 115 shared cases and native-policy parity. Opt-in URLSession transport now has bounded streaming, deadlines/cancellation, host race/TLS-negative tests and cross-builds; root reviewed the source and matched evidence. Actual guest/JNI integration, Android network packaging/trust behavior, physical lifecycle, immutable FieldLog plugin adoption and full W06 acceptance remain open.

packages.name: Guest compilation
packages.deliverables: Guest libraries, module extraction, API diagnostics, source maps, dependency closure
packages.acceptance: FieldLog feature graph compiles to native and Wasm with no silent behavior loss.
packages.remaining: Actual FieldLog baseline1587d2d model behavior matches host, physical Android and full Swift WASI development oracle. Eleven full-SDK size variants preserve sampled observations; best 52,008,982 bytes/18,852,048 gzip exceeds 3MiB budget. ICU alone accounts for 33,976,096 linked data bytes; removal is unqualified. Owned VM still rejects full artifact. Full feature/UI/effect closure, host ABI, source maps, owned Swift execution and all performance budgets remain open. Bounded layout/session measurements quantify current eager decoding; the full corpus arithmetic is an estimate, not a measured full-corpus heap/RSS run. Production memory architecture and ceilings remain unqualified. Sequential diagnostic parsing now measures all 79,837 function bodies, with six unchanged nesting rejections. It does not validate or execute the full module; complete streaming validation is a separate nondefault experiment under unchanged profiles.

packages.name: Owned interpreter
packages.deliverables: Validator/interpreter, resource controls, imports, Swift runtime integration, debugger
packages.acceptance: D3, standards-profile tests, fuzzing and differential results.
packages.remaining: Owned bounded profiles and initial C sessions have scoped physical evidence. Independent session quota race fix, typed Swift wrapper and complete pre-staging validation pass host tests. Signed cold-start composition passes host review and 11 simulator cases; new physical checks remain pending. Full Swift imports/resource architecture, capability/UI integration, debugging, standards/fuzz/audit and D3 remain open. Sequential diagnostic parsing now measures all 79,837 function bodies, with six unchanged nesting rejections. It does not validate or execute the full module; complete streaming validation is a separate nondefault experiment under unchanged profiles.

packages.name: First-party integrations
packages.deliverables: All capability families in Section 9, plugin authoring guide
packages.acceptance: FieldLog flows pass on both devices; native additions correctly require binary changes.
packages.remaining: Real app-private key-value storage and opt-in native URLSession transport implemented with scoped host/cross-compiler receipts. Android network packaging/trust behavior, remaining Section9 capability families, real guest integration, published FieldLog plugin adoption and physical two-platform workflows remain open.

packages.name: Device updater
packages.deliverables: Verifier, cache, activation, health, quarantine, recovery, key rotation
packages.acceptance: D4–05, data-preserving rollback, offline recovery, fault matrix.
packages.remaining: Durable store has earlier scoped physical recovery receipts. New signed v1/v2 selection into bounded owned VM enforces installed/signed limits, retained state, health and candidate/healthy/native fallback, passing 11 simulator cases and 15 independent host cases. Actual compiled feature fallback integration, full Swift/UI/capabilities, physical lifecycle/power-loss, healthy guest quarantine policy, state migration, key rotation and D4-D5 remain open.

packages.name: Release backend
packages.deliverables: Artifacts, compatibility, channels, assignment signing, rollout/rollback, API
packages.acceptance: Dual-platform release with immutable audit and correct cohort routing.
packages.remaining: Local PostgreSQL17 tenant transactions, forced RLS, immutable audit/history/outbox and crash/retry controls pass scoped tests. Independent review found and fixed unsafe schema/function ownership and unknown migration version acceptance; root reviewed the committed fix and matched evidence. Signed protocol v2 grants are implemented separately; HTTP v2 composition, hosted identity, dispatch, deployment/backup/failover and full release approval remain open.
